name: things
description: Tooling for taking screenshots and dev-server-ing Dan Q's Things

scripts.watch: nodemon --watch source --watch data --watch screenshots --ext "html,erb,css,scss,sass,js,yml,yaml,webp,png,jpg,jpeg,gif,svg,woff,woff2" --exec "npm run build"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n build,serve -c blue,green "npm run watch" "npm run serve"
